heard: A massive asteroid once reached the highest hazard rating in history. In 2004, astronomers calculated that asteroid Apophis had a 2.7% chance of hitting Earth. It was the first object to ever hit level 4 on the Torino scale. Radar data from 2021 eventually ruled out an impact for at least a century. But on Friday, April 13, 2029, the 450-meter rock will still sweep incredibly close. Apophis will pass within 31,600 kilometers, flying lower than many of our own satellites. Billions of people across Europe and Africa can watch it with the naked eye. Earth's gravity will even stretch the asteroid's surface and trigger minor landslides. This intense, cosmic encounter will forever alter the orbit of this massive asteroid.
